question: The ancient Neemrana Baori is located in which of the following districts of Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alwar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• Rani Ki Baoli is also known as Neemrana Baori in the local language.
 
• It is a 12-floor stepwell built for famine relief in Neemrana.
 
• It is located in **Alwar Rajasthan.**
 
• It had a Majestic design built to protect it from the scorching heat outside.
 
• As it was completely neglected now only ruins are remaining.
 
• It is located in Neemrana, Rajasthan.
